```artifact
Feature: Alarms Configuration

  Scenario: HIGH RR Alarm Threshold Setting
    Given the HIGH RR alarm threshold is set to 10
    When the user sets the HIGH RR alarm threshold to 15
    Then the HIGH RR alarm threshold is set to 15

  Scenario: LOW RR Alarm Threshold Setting
    Given the LOW RR alarm threshold is set to 15
    When the user sets the LOW RR alarm threshold to 20
    Then the LOW RR alarm threshold is set to 20

  Scenario: Apnea Alarm Threshold Setting
    Given the apnea alarm threshold is set to 5 seconds
    When the user sets the apnea alarm threshold to 10 seconds
    Then the apnea alarm threshold is set to 10 seconds

  Scenario: HIGH RR Alarm Threshold Validation
    Given the HIGH RR alarm threshold is set to 10
    When the user sets the HIGH RR alarm threshold to 4
    Then the HIGH RR alarm threshold is set to 5

  Scenario: LOW RR Alarm Threshold Validation
    Given the LOW RR alarm threshold is set to 15
    When the user sets the LOW RR alarm threshold to 31
    Then the LOW RR alarm threshold is set to 30

  Scenario: Apnea Alarm Threshold Validation
    Given the apnea alarm threshold is set to 5 seconds
    When the user sets the apnea alarm threshold to 0 seconds
    Then the apnea alarm threshold is set to 1

  Scenario: Alarm Triggering
    Given the HIGH RR alarm threshold is set to 10
    When the HIGH RR value exceeds 10
    Then the HIGH RR alarm is triggered

  Scenario: Alarm Triggering (Apnea)
    Given the apnea alarm threshold is set to 5 seconds
    When the apnea duration exceeds 5 seconds
    Then the apnea alarm is triggered

  Scenario: Relief Valve Open Alarm
    Given the relief valve open alarm is disabled
    When the relief valve opens unexpectedly
    Then the relief valve open alarm is triggered

  Scenario Outline: Alarm Threshold Increment
    Given the HIGH RR alarm threshold is set to <threshold>
    When the user increments the HIGH RR alarm threshold by 1
    Then the HIGH RR alarm threshold is set to <new_threshold>

    Examples:
      | threshold | new_threshold |
      | 5         | 6             |
      | 10        | 11            |
      | 20        | 21            |

  Scenario Outline: Alarm Threshold Validation (Non-Integer)
    Given the HIGH RR alarm threshold is set to <threshold>
    When the user sets the HIGH RR alarm threshold to <invalid_value>
    Then the HIGH RR alarm threshold is set to <threshold>

    Examples:
      | threshold | invalid_value |
      | 5         | 3.14          |
      | 10        | abc           |
      | 20        | 25.5          |

  Scenario Outline: Alarm Threshold Validation (Out-of-Range)
    Given the HIGH RR alarm threshold is set to <threshold>
    When the user sets the HIGH RR alarm threshold to <invalid_value>
    Then the HIGH RR alarm threshold is set to <threshold>

    Examples:
      | threshold | invalid_value |
      | 5         | 4             |
      | 10        | 31            |
      | 20        | 0             |
```
